entries.name: box_r0_is_defined-errored#2
entries.script: `SELF.R0.isDefined` with R0 as a PropertyCall (SBox id 9). **The JVM PARSES it and CANNOT INVOKE it:** `NoSuchMethodException: sigma.Box.R0()`. The descriptor is `R0[T](implicit cT: RType[T])`, so a reflective lookup for a no-arg `R0()` finds nothing — the probe's own suspicion, confirmed. The dedicated `ExtractRegisterAs` node does the same job at cost 60.  // row 3 of the probe

entries.name: box_r4_is_defined-errored#3
entries.script: `SELF.R4.isDefined` (SBox id 13). Same `NoSuchMethodException: sigma.Box.R4()`. R0 is mandatory and R4 is not, and it makes NO difference — the failure is the lookup, before any register is read, so all ten of R0..R9 are dead the same way.  // row 4 of the probe

entries.name: option_get_none-errored#7
entries.script: `Global.none[Int].get` — the method INVOKES and then throws, as Scala's `Option.get` does on `None`: `InvocationTargetException`. Note the contrast with rows 3/4/9/10, where the lookup itself fails — this row reached the method and that one did not, and only the class tells them apart.  // row 8 of the probe

entries.name: option_get_or_else_some-errored#8
entries.script: `Global.some[Int](5).getOrElse(9)` — SOption id 4, Fixed 20. **PARSES and CANNOT BE INVOKED:** `NoSuchMethodException: scala.Option.getOrElse(int)`. Scala's `getOrElse` takes a BY-NAME default (`Function0`), so no `getOrElse(int)` exists — the probe's second suspicion, also confirmed. The dedicated `OptionGetOrElse` node works, at cost 30.  // row 9 of the probe

entries.name: option_get_or_else_none-errored#9
entries.script: `Global.none[Int].getOrElse(9)`. The same `NoSuchMethodException` — the receiver being `none` changes nothing, because the lookup fails before the receiver is used.  // row 10 of the probe
